set.body: Build the first high-level fmrireg-style construction path. Deliverables: a typed builder that turns FmriDataset.events plus a formula/event specification and default baseline policy into FmriModel/FitPlan; preserve inspectability before execution; reject row/event/sampling mismatches explicitly. Acceptance: JVM and Scala.js tests construct a model from dataset-resident events, execute OLS through FitPlanExecutor, and recover known coefficients without hand-assembling EventModel in the test.
set.title: Slice 4: model builder from dataset events
